title: Meniscal Signal Grading
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Assess internal signal on the proton density or intermediate weighted images, where degenerate tissue and a tear both produce signal against a dark background.
Confirm on a fluid sensitive sequence, since a tear filled with fluid is bright there.
Decide, for each area of signal, whether it reaches an articular surface, which is the question the grade turns on.
Check it on two consecutive slices and in both planes, because signal on one slice in one plane is usually artefact or partial volume.
Record the location by horn and by zone, since the zone predicts whether a tear can heal.
